objective: Consolidate the P52 Data Acquisition v1 foundation into a source-neutral execution path that can run registered adapters from immutable run manifests, while preserving YouTube Q-Diving as the reference adapter and proving the complete path through deterministic fixture replay.
queue_purpose_summary: รวม foundation ให้เหลือ runner และ registry กลางที่เสถียร โดย pin ทุก run ด้วย immutable manifest, ย้าย YouTube มาใช้เส้นทางกลางจริง และเตรียมฐานให้ source ถัดไปเพิ่ม adapter+manifest ได้โดยไม่แก้ runner หรือ workflow.

requirements: one authoritative source-neutral runner owns lifecycle orchestration and invokes Connector Kit contracts
runner accepts only validated immutable run manifests and resolves adapters through Adapter Registry V1
runner must not contain source IDs, endpoints, selectors, payload parsing or domain semantic-quality rules
unknown adapters, unsupported capabilities, manifest-version drift and boundary violations fail closed
create a versioned closed schema and validator

pin run ID, source manifest, adapter and parser/mapper versions, domain capability profile, requested capabilities, transport mode, fixture/evidence references, request policy, timestamps, hashes and authority boundaries
manifest is append-only after execution begins; corrections create a new manifest/version rather than rewriting executed evidence
record provider request/quota counts and production/scheduler boundaries explicitly
register adapters by stable source and adapter version without dynamic arbitrary imports
reject duplicate registrations, unknown IDs and incompatible contract versions
separate registration metadata from source implementation
allow a future source adapter and manifest to be added without modifying runner logic
route the existing YouTube Q-Diving adapter, parser and domain mapper through the generic runner and registry
preserve the ten sanitized candidates, ordering, provenance, Analysis handoff and MTC status
do not retrieve comments, captions, transcripts or raw provider payloads
do not move semantic relevance, ranking or inclusion decisions back into Acquisition

required_deliverables.component: Fixture Replay and Early Acquisition Quality Gate
requirements: exercise the complete manifest-to-registry-to-runner-to-Connector-Kit-to-parser-to-mapper path using deterministic fixtures
quality gate checks authority, schema, provenance, timestamps, sanitization, exact technical duplication rules and evidence completeness before Analysis handoff
quality gate must not score semantic relevance or make final inclusion decisions
fixture replay must prove zero provider requests and zero quota
document the extension seam for P54: add source adapter, parser/mapper, capability profile, source manifest, immutable run manifest and fixtures without changing generic runner/workflow
retain one Source Completion Queue, three-level testing and multi-correction single-PR journaling
avoid compatibility-wrapper accumulation; migrate authoritative paths and document any temporary shim with removal criteria

instructions: Inspect the merged P52 implementation and reuse its authoritative Connector Kit, capability, source-manifest, MTC, evidence, logging and correction-journal modules before editing.
Implement the smallest coherent Foundation Consolidation needed for P54; do not implement TikTok or speculative provider-specific capabilities.
Keep all technical corrections within P53 and KU2D-CJ-000003; do not open a queue or PR per correction.
Use deterministic fixtures throughout normal development. A live smoke is optional, never a completion requirement, and may occur only under the explicit one-request boundary in H22.

Create one Ready PR to integration/data-acquisition-platform only after Level 2 passes. Run the full deterministic corpus once on the final exact PR head, verify applicable CI and tree identity, then merge when technically green.

Submit KU2D-R-000054 with changed files, registry/manifest/runner evidence, YouTube parity, quality-gate evidence, correction journal, tests by level, PR/CI/merge metadata, provider/quota accounting, remaining limitations and explicit P54 readiness.
stop_conditions: implementation requires TikTok or another new source execution
more than one live provider request is required
quota cost, legal/policy authority, credential scope or personal/restricted-data handling is unclear
production write, scheduling, new spending, main modification or elevated authority is required
immutable P52 evidence or historical coordination records would need rewriting
repository permission or protected-branch policy blocks the authorized merge
definition_of_done: generic source runner executes validated immutable run manifests through Adapter Registry V1
run-manifest and registry schemas/validators fail closed on drift and unknown identities
YouTube reference adapter passes through the generic path with ten candidates and provenance unchanged
early acquisition quality gate remains technical and Analysis retains semantic quality
fixture replay proves zero provider requests and quota in the normal path
extension contract shows P54 can add a source adapter and manifest without runner/workflow changes
KU2D-CJ-000003 is finalized with all material corrections and commit links
Level 1, Level 2 and one final exact-head full deterministic corpus pass
one technically green PR is merged to integration/data-acquisition-platform
KU2D-R-000054 is submitted for Assistant review
